A01.title_en: MOS control: gate voltage to drain current
A01.title_zh: MOS控制：栅压如何改变漏电流
A01.explanation_en: Raise the gate voltage and compare drain current, transconductance and gm/Id. A DC sweep is a sequence of bias points, not a switching event.
A01.explanation_zh: 升高栅压，对照漏电流、跨导及gm/Id。直流扫描是不同偏置点，并不是开关瞬态。
A01.scope_en: Low-voltage interpolation; no breakdown or physical field solution.
A01.scope_zh: 仅0–1.8V低压示意；无雪崩、栅漏、DIBL、速度饱和、内禀电荷分配或实测拟合；不是完整EKV/BSIM。
A01.limits_en: 0–1.8 V low-voltage demonstration. No avalanche, oxide leakage, DIBL, velocity saturation, intrinsic charge partition or measured fit. Not full EKV/BSIM.
A01.limits_zh: 仅0–1.8V低压示意；无雪崩、栅漏、DIBL、速度饱和、内禀电荷分配或实测拟合；不是完整EKV/BSIM。
A01.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked

A02.explanation_en: Reverse bias changes depletion capacitance. Charge is the integral of capacitance, not C(V) times V for a nonlinear junction.
A02.explanation_zh: 反向偏置改变耗尽电容。对非线性结，电荷为电容的电压积分，不能直接用C(V)乘V。
A02.scope_en: DC C-V/Q-V sweep; no moving depletion boundary or transient current is implied.
A02.scope_zh: 仅耗尽电容，-20≤V<0.35V；不含正向扩散电荷、击穿和串联电阻；反向漏电假设为1pA。
A02.limits_en: Depletion capacitance only, -20 <= V < 0.35 V. No forward diffusion charge, breakdown or series resistance. Reverse leakage is an assumed 1 pA.
A02.limits_zh: 仅耗尽电容，-20≤V<0.35V；不含正向扩散电荷、击穿和串联电阻；反向漏电假设为1pA。
A02.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked

A03.explanation_en: A small Vbe increase gives a large current change. Collector and base currents use a log scale. Terminal currents follow the into-device convention.
A03.explanation_zh: Vbe稍微增加即可显著改变电流。集电流与基电流采用对数纵轴；端口电流按流入器件为正。
A03.scope_en: Low-injection DC Ebers-Moll; no carrier transit animation or breakdown.
A03.limits_en: Generic silicon NPN, not a SiGe HBT. Low-injection DC only; no Early effect, high injection, transit time, RF fT or breakdown.
A03.limits_zh: 通用硅NPN，不是SiGe HBT；仅低注入直流，不含Early效应、大注入、渡越时间、fT及击穿。
A03.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
A03.scope_zh: 通用硅NPN，不是SiGe HBT；仅低注入直流，不含Early效应、大注入、渡越时间、fT及击穿。

A04.title_en: Matched MOS pairs: common shift and difference
A04.title_zh: MOS配对：共同偏移与差分失配
A04.explanation_en: Each cursor position is a different random sample. Common variation can cancel in the pair difference. Only 512 display samples are shown; summary statistics use 80,000.
A04.explanation_zh: 每个光标位置对应不同随机样本；共同变化可在配对差中抵消。图上仅显示512个样本，汇总统计使用80000个样本。
A04.equation: Delta Vth(pair) = delta Vth1 - delta Vth2
A04.scope_en: Sample index is not time; symbols do not show physical motion.
A04.limits_en: Assumed Gaussian local mismatch and correlation. No foundry statistics, spatial-gradient fit, yield certification or temperature-dependent mismatch law.
A04.limits_zh: 高斯局部失配和相关系数为假设；无工艺统计、空间梯度拟合、良率认证或温度失配律。
A04.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
A04.scope_zh: 高斯局部失配和相关系数为假设；无工艺统计、空间梯度拟合、良率认证或温度失配律。

B01.title_en: Differential pair: steering a fixed tail current
B01.title_zh: 差分对：分配固定尾电流
B01.explanation_en: The differential input redistributes current between two branches. The tail source fixes the sum, while the shared source voltage adjusts.
B01.explanation_zh: 差分输入把电流重新分配到两个支路；尾电流源固定总电流，共源节点电压随之调整。
B01.scope_en: Static pair model; no high-frequency settling or offset extraction.
B01.limits_en: Fixed drain biases and ideal tail source. No amplifier load, common-mode feedback, frequency compensation or finite tail impedance.
B01.limits_zh: 固定漏端偏置、理想尾电流源；不含放大器负载、共模反馈、频率补偿及尾源有限阻抗。
B01.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B01.scope_zh: 固定漏端偏置、理想尾电流源；不含放大器负载、共模反馈、频率补偿及尾源有限阻抗。

B02.title_en: Reference design: combine opposite temperature slopes
B02.title_zh: 基准设计：组合相反的温度斜率
B02.explanation_en: Vbe falls with temperature; the weighted PTAT term rises. Their sum is flatter, but curvature remains. The cursor changes temperature, not elapsed time.
B02.explanation_zh: Vbe随温度下降，加权PTAT项随温度上升，二者求和更平坦但仍有曲率。光标代表温度而不是时间。
B02.equation: Vref = Vbe + K x Delta Vbe
B02.scope_en: Algebraic reference sum; no startup circuit or thermal transient.
B02.limits_en: Ideal voltage sum inspired by bandgap principles, not the 2.5 V Brokaw circuit reproduction. No start-up, PSRR, trimming, resistor TC, mismatch or output load.
B02.limits_zh: 按带隙原理的理想电压合成，并非复现Brokaw的2.5V电路；不含启动、PSRR、修调、电阻温漂、失配及输出负载。
B02.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B02.scope_zh: 按带隙原理的理想电压合成，并非复现Brokaw的2.5V电路；不含启动、PSRR、修调、电阻温漂、失配及输出负载。

B03.title_en: Noise spectrum: density is not total noise
B03.title_zh: 噪声谱：噪声密度不等于总噪声
B03.explanation_en: At each frequency, compare amplitude spectral density. Integrated noise uses the area under PSD, which is ASD squared. Low-frequency suppression can raise wideband noise.
B03.explanation_zh: 逐频率比较幅度谱密度。积分噪声使用功率谱密度即ASD平方的面积；低频抑制可能伴随宽带噪声增加。
B03.scope_en: Analytic spectrum; no generated random time-domain noise trace.
B03.limits_en: Illustrative spectral shaping, not a switched chopper circuit or measured op amp. No current noise, source resistance, aliasing, ripple or charge injection.
B03.limits_zh: 仅示意频谱整形，不是开关斩波电路或实测运放；不含电流噪声、源阻、混叠、纹波和电荷注入。
B03.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B03.scope_zh: 仅示意频谱整形，不是开关斩波电路或实测运放；不含电流噪声、源阻、混叠、纹波和电荷注入。

B04.title_en: SAR ADC: sampled input, code and quantization error
B04.title_zh: SAR ADC：采样输入、输出码与量化误差
B04.explanation_en: The cursor advances through saved input samples. The reconstruction uses the final conversion code; the error is reconstructed minus input voltage. Internal bit trials are not animated.
B04.explanation_zh: 光标逐个经过保存的输入样本。重建电压由最终输出码得到；误差为重建值减输入值。动画没有模拟内部逐次比较时序。
B04.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
B04.scope_en: Mismatch case; no comparator dynamics, switch settling or timing solver.
B04.limits_en: Ideal comparator and full settling. No aperture jitter, thermal/comparator noise, switch leakage, reference droop or supply-current prediction. Capacitor mismatch is assumed.
B04.limits_zh: 比较器理想且完全建立；不含采样抖动、热噪声/比较器噪声、开关漏电、参考跌落及供电电流预测；电容失配为假设。
B04.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B04.scope_zh: 比较器理想且完全建立；不含采样抖动、热噪声/比较器噪声、开关漏电、参考跌落及供电电流预测；电容失配为假设。

B05.title_en: LDO load step: capacitor support and pass-current recovery
B05.title_zh: LDO负载阶跃：电容支撑与调整管电流恢复
B05.explanation_en: After the load changes, the pass current needs time to respond. The output capacitor supplies the current difference, causing a voltage dip and finite-gain steady error.
B05.explanation_zh: 负载改变后，调整管电流需要时间响应；输出电容提供差额电流，因此产生跌落及有限增益导致的稳态误差。
B05.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
B05.scope_en: Reduced LDO model; no dropout, transistor SOA or package extraction.
B05.limits_en: Small perturbation around a biased operating point; no dropout, current limit, start-up, ESR zero or transistor netlist. Not a reproduction of the cited measured LDO.
B05.limits_zh: 围绕偏置点的小扰动模型；无压差极限、限流、启动、ESR零点或晶体管网表；并非复现引用论文的实测LDO。
B05.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B05.scope_zh: 围绕偏置点的小扰动模型；无压差极限、限流、启动、ESR零点或晶体管网表；并非复现引用论文的实测LDO。

B06.title_zh: 锁相环：相位修正与阻尼
B06.explanation_en: A phase step is corrected by changing oscillator frequency. Damping controls overshoot and settling. Phase is an angle; it is not the oscillator voltage waveform.
B06.explanation_zh: 相位阶跃通过改变振荡频率得到修正；阻尼决定过冲与稳定时间。相位是角度，并非振荡器电压波形。
B06.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
B06.scope_en: Linear phase-domain model; no transistor VCO or cycle-slip simulation.
B06.limits_en: Canonical phase-domain abstraction without a loop zero. Not a transistor VCO, a full type-II PLL, ISF extraction, cycle-slip or acquisition simulation.
B06.limits_zh: 无环路零点的典型相位域抽象；不是晶体管VCO、完整二型PLL、ISF提取、周跳或捕获仿真。
B06.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B06.scope_zh: 无环路零点的典型相位域抽象；不是晶体管VCO、完整二型PLL、ISF提取、周跳或捕获仿真。

B07.title_en: Buck power stage: voltage, current and output ripple
B07.title_zh: Buck功率级：电压、电流与输出纹波
B07.explanation_en: The switching node drives inductor current up and down. The LC state is integrated, so output ripple is calculated here. This view shows the first saved switching cycle.
B07.explanation_zh: 开关节点使电感电流上升或下降；该模型积分LC状态，因此这里计算了输出纹波。本图显示首个保存的开关周期。
B07.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
B07.equation: L dIL/dt = Vsw - Vout - R_L IL
B07.scope_en: Ideal gate commands and conduction losses; no dead time, Qrr or gate dynamics.
B07.limits_en: Forced CCM with ideal instantaneous switches. Efficiency includes conduction loss only; no switching/gate/core loss, dead time, ringing, control-loop start-up, SOA or validated voltage rating.
B07.limits_zh: 强制连续导通、理想瞬时开关；效率仅含导通损耗；无开关/栅极/磁芯损耗、死区、振铃、控制启动、SOA或已验证耐压。
B07.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
B07.scope_zh: 强制连续导通、理想瞬时开关；效率仅含导通损耗；无开关/栅极/磁芯损耗、死区、振铃、控制启动、SOA或已验证耐压。

P01.title_en: MOS turn-on: gate charging and Miller plateau
P01.explanation_en: During the Miller interval, gate charge changes drain voltage while Vgs stays near a plateau. The channel-current and gate-current traces are distinct quantities.
P01.explanation_zh: Miller阶段中，栅电荷改变漏压而Vgs停留在平台附近；沟道电流与栅电流是两个不同量。
P01.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P01.equation: Ig = (Vdrive - Vgs)/Rg; Qgd = integral Cgd dV
P01.scope_en: Prescribed commutation; not a fully coupled charge-conserving MOS solver.
P01.limits_en: Prescribed staged commutation, not a coupled charge-conserving MOS compact model. Ichannel excludes Coss displacement and diode recovery. Fixed-C Miller appeared in V2 X01; this bench adds nonlinear charge, separate overlap/storage energies and temperature sweeps. No breakdown, avalanche, SOA, gate overshoot or layout extraction. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P01.limits_zh: 人为规定阶段的换流模型，非完整电荷守恒MOS紧凑模型；沟道电流不含Coss位移和二极管恢复。V2 X01已有固定电容Miller，本版增强非线性电荷、分离交叠/储能及温度扫描；不含击穿、雪崩、SOA、栅过冲或版图提取。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
P01.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
P01.scope_zh: 人为规定阶段的换流模型，非完整电荷守恒MOS紧凑模型；沟道电流不含Coss位移和二极管恢复。V2 X01已有固定电容Miller，本版增强非线性电荷、分离交叠/储能及温度扫描；不含击穿、雪崩、SOA、栅过冲或版图提取。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P02.title_en: Dead time: the positive inductor current keeps flowing
P02.title_zh: 死区：正向电感电流仍然续流
P02.explanation_en: During dead time both gate commands are OFF, but the low-side diode carries positive inductor current. Each interval is given display time so the short dead times remain visible.
P02.explanation_zh: 死区内两个栅命令均关断，但低侧二极管仍承载正向电感电流。各区间分配显示时间，使很短的死区也能看清。
P02.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P02.scope_en: Fixed 12 V output; separate prescribed reverse recovery is not added to this trace.
P02.limits_en: Periodic ideal CCM waveform; recovery pulse is separate from IL and Vsw. Vin Qrr assumes full bus voltage and is not measured diode heat. No stored-charge transport solution, Coss commutation, gate overlap or ringing. V2 X02 already imposed triangular recovery; V3.2 relates it to dead-time sizing and bus-energy accounting. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P02.limits_zh: 周期理想CCM波形；恢复脉冲与IL、Vsw分别计算。VinQrr假定全母线电压，不等同实测二极管热。无载流子输运、Coss换流、栅交叠或振铃。V2 X02已有三角恢复，本版关联死区选取和母线能量核算。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
P02.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
P02.scope_zh: 周期理想CCM波形；恢复脉冲与IL、Vsw分别计算。VinQrr假定全母线电压，不等同实测二极管热。无载流子输运、Coss换流、栅交叠或振铃。V2 X02已有三角恢复，本版关联死区选取和母线能量核算。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P03.title_en: Bootstrap supply: consume charge, then recharge
P03.title_zh: 自举电源：消耗电荷后再补充
P03.explanation_en: Gate-charge removal lowers VBS. When the recharge path is available, current restores it toward the supply-minus-diode limit. The final two cycles are shown.
P03.explanation_zh: 栅电荷消耗降低VBS；补充通路开放时，电流把它恢复到电源减去二极管压降的上限。这里显示最后两个周期。
P03.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P03.scope_en: Lumped charge budget; local VBS is not the gate voltage relative to ground.
P03.limits_en: VBS is gate-driver supply relative to switching source, not absolute gate voltage. UVLO flags a sizing violation without disabling the prescribed gate-charge pulses. No negative-SW overcharge, diode leakage/recovery, startup recharge sequence, high-side common-mode isolation or high-duty operation qualification. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P03.limits_zh: VBS相对开关源极，非绝对栅压；欠压仅标记选值失败，不关闭规定栅电荷脉冲。不含负SW过充、二极管漏电/恢复、启动充电序列、高侧共模隔离或高占空比认证。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
P03.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
P03.scope_zh: VBS相对开关源极，非绝对栅压；欠压仅标记选值失败，不关闭规定栅电荷脉冲。不含负SW过充、二极管漏电/恢复、启动充电序列、高侧共模隔离或高占空比认证。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P04.title_en: Level shifter: common-mode edge injects current
P04.title_zh: 电平移位：共模边沿注入电流
P04.explanation_en: A changing common-mode voltage injects displacement current through a small coupling capacitance. The receiver resistance and capacitance determine its disturbance.
P04.explanation_zh: 变化的共模电压经小耦合电容注入位移电流；接收端电阻和电容决定扰动幅度。
P04.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P04.scope_en: Linear disturbance model; no full latch logic or measured CMTI qualification.
P04.limits_en: Unclamped linear RC susceptibility only. Receiver excursions beyond a real logic rail signal model invalidity/risk; no receiver clamp or latch transistor network is modeled. This is not a level-shifter implementation, isolation test or CMTI certification. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P04.limits_zh: 仅未钳位线性RC敏感性；超过实际逻辑电源的电压提示模型适用边界/风险，未建模输入钳位或锁存晶体管。不代表完整电平移位电路、隔离测试或CMTI认证。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
P04.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
P04.scope_zh: 仅未钳位线性RC敏感性；超过实际逻辑电源的电压提示模型适用边界/风险，未建模输入钳位或锁存晶体管。不代表完整电平移位电路、隔离测试或CMTI认证。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P05.title_en: Current sensing: filtering and comparator delay
P05.title_zh: 电流检测：滤波与比较器延迟
P05.explanation_en: The shunt turns current into voltage. The amplifier responds with finite bandwidth, then a delayed comparator changes state. Detection does not stop the prescribed load current here.
P05.explanation_zh: 取样电阻把电流变成电压；放大器具有有限带宽，比较器再经延迟改变状态。本模型检测后不会切断预设负载电流。
P05.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P05.scope_en: Sensing bench only; comparator output is not a simulated shutdown loop.
P05.limits_en: Low-voltage ground-referenced sensing bench. No HV input/common-mode rating, amplifier saturation, input clamp, blanking, random noise, metastability, shunt inductance or actual cycle-by-cycle turn-off. Delay is assumed, not a guaranteed device specification. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P05.limits_zh: 低压地参考检测台；无高压共模额定、放大器饱和、输入钳位、消隐、随机噪声、亚稳态、取样寄生电感及实际逐周期关断。延迟为假设，非器件保证值。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
P05.validation: decoded all frames; dimensions, timing and hashes checked
P05.scope_zh: 低压地参考检测台；无高压共模额定、放大器饱和、输入钳位、消隐、随机噪声、亚稳态、取样寄生电感及实际逐周期关断。延迟为假设，非器件保证值。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P06.title_en: Startup supply: charge storage and UVLO hysteresis
P06.title_zh: 启动供电：储能与欠压迟滞
P06.explanation_en: The startup source charges Caux before enable. Different ON/OFF thresholds prevent a single-threshold toggle. The prescribed supply interruption creates a brownout and restart.
P06.explanation_zh: 启动源先给Caux充电再使能；不同开启与关闭阈值形成迟滞。预设供电中断导致掉电与重新启动。
P06.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P06.scope_en: Lumped startup source and ideal clamp; no HV transistor stress solution.
P06.limits_en: Behavioral startup current source, not a JFET transistor model. The source remains on except for an imposed interruption. No real auxiliary winding handover, high-voltage reliability, clamp SOA, leakage, power-on reset timing or guaranteed start-up range. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P06.limits_zh: 启动限流源为行为模型，非JFET晶体管模型；除规定中断外保持开启。不含真实辅助绕组接管、高压可靠性、钳位SOA、漏电、上电复位时序或保证启动范围。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P07.title_en: Parasitic ringing: stored energy becomes damping loss
P07.title_zh: 寄生振铃：储能转化为阻尼损耗
P07.explanation_en: An imposed initial voltage excess excites the parasitic LC loop. Series resistance removes its stored energy. The early 60 ns show the damped response.
P07.explanation_zh: 预设初始过压激发寄生LC环路；串联电阻耗散储能。前60 ns展示阻尼响应。
P07.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P07.scope_en: Initial-condition RLC response; not a solved MOS switching edge or extracted layout.
P07.limits_en: Linearized series-RLC surrogate about a bus voltage, not a literal shunt RC snubber design. Initial disturbance amplitude is prescribed. No switching-edge excitation, EMI prediction, nonlinear Coss or snubber recurring power estimate. Do not copy its Rcritical into a real shunt snubber. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P07.limits_zh: 母线附近线性化串联RLC替代模型，不是实际并联RC吸收器设计；初始扰动人为规定。无开关边沿激励、EMI预测、非线性Coss或吸收器周期功率；不得将临界电阻直接用于真实并联吸收器。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P08.title_en: Loss budget: power becomes temperature rise
P08.title_zh: 损耗预算：功率转化为温升
P08.explanation_en: The fixed-point loss ledger sets a thermal RC step response. The bars are the steady operating loss components, not instantaneous switching power.
P08.explanation_zh: 固定点损耗账本驱动热RC阶跃响应。条形图是稳态工作点的损耗分项，并非瞬时开关功率。
P08.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P08.scope_en: One effective thermal node; no package heat map or independent device junction temperatures.
P08.limits_en: A ledger, not one self-consistent switched electrical/thermal simulation. Two matched Coss curves, one hard upper turn-on per cycle, opposite edge ideal energy redistribution; Coss subterm energies are explanatory and only their sum enters the loss ledger. Overlap includes load-channel current only; Qrr is separate, with no reused full Eon. Vin Qrr is conservative full-bus energy, not diode heat. All heat shares one effective node, not a MOS junction; the thermal transient holds converged loss constant. No core/ESR/reliability/layout loss or measured efficiency. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P08.limits_zh: 此为预算表，非完整自洽开关电热仿真；两管Coss相同，每周期一次高侧硬导通，另一边沿假定理想能量再分配；Coss子项能量用于解释，仅其和计入损耗。交叠仅含负载沟道电流，Qrr单列，不重复使用完整Eon。VinQrr为全母线保守能量，非二极管热；所有热量共用一个等效节点，非MOS结温，热瞬态固定收敛损耗。不含磁芯、ESR、可靠性、版图损耗或实测效率。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。

P09.title_en: Averaged buck: soft-start and current-reference limiting
P09.title_zh: 平均Buck：软启动与电流参考限幅
P09.explanation_en: The reference ramps up, then a load change asks for more current. The clipped current command limits the average current; output voltage can fall when demand is too high.
P09.explanation_zh: 参考电压缓慢上升，负载改变后要求更高电流；电流指令限幅约束平均电流，需求过大时输出电压下降。
P09.axis_zh: 物理时间（播放速度经过调整）
P09.equation: L dIL/dt = D Vin - R IL - Vout
P09.scope_en: Average control states; no PWM ripple, per-cycle current trip or transistor switching.
P09.limits_en: Continuous averaged duty, not PWM edges. A current-reference ceiling is not cycle-by-cycle peak protection; high-frequency overshoot, blanking and inductor saturation are absent. P08 switching losses are not inserted into this plant. Saved traces are decimated; energy metrics use every integration step. No sampled-cycle, slope-compensation, subharmonic or hardware-stability prediction. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
P09.limits_zh: 连续平均占空比，非PWM边沿；电流参考上限不是逐周期峰值保护，无高频过冲、消隐与电感饱和。未将P08开关损耗注入功率级；显示曲线抽取，能量指标使用全部积分步。不预测采样周期、斜坡补偿、次谐波或硬件稳定性。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
